Commentary.Commentary: Milton Shumba is also the Player of the Series.
Milton Shumba is the Player of the Match.

Right then. Zimbabwe take the series 2-1 and that is all we have from this game. It has been a pleasure to bring this series to you. There is plenty of cricketing action this month with the Indian T20 League getting underway. Make sure you join us for that! Take care and goodbye!

Scotland did not get early wickets. Alasdair Evans took 1 and Michael Leask took 2 in the middle overs to make sure that Zimbabwe were under pressure after a good start. They were in control of the game but the 17th over, in which Alasdair Evans went for 25 runs took the game away from them. They could never recover from that.

Zimbabwe had a good start with Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine leading the way at the top. But both of them fell after getting a start. Sean Williams too fell early and Milton Shumba joined Wesley Madhevere in the middle. They took it slow at the start and the required rate was climbing up. Towards the end though, Milton Shumba teed off and sent the ball sailing all over the park to get his team over the line.

TAKE A BOW, MILTON SHUMBA! TAKE A BOW, ZIMBABWE! They were in a tough spot at one stage but Milton Shumba batted brilliantly to take them home. A brilliant knock by him and Zimbabwe have taken the series 2-1.
FOUR! That is it! Full outside off, Burl drives it through cover for a boundary. ZIMBABWE WIN BY 6 WICKETS.

LEG BYES! Short ball on middle, Shumba looks to pull but it goes off the pads to the off side. They take off for a leg bye. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and the batters take another. Just 2 needed in the final over.
FOUR! This is some innings from Shumba! Full on middle, Shumba dances down the track and then lifts it to long off for a boundary. Just 4 needed now.
NO BALL! Not the right time to bowl a No Ball! Very full on middle, Burl works it down to long on for one. A Free Hit will follow.
Full on middle, Shumba works it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Zimbabwe edging closer! Full outside off, Shumba looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
On middle, Burl pushes it to the off side for one.
Ryan Burl walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! The dive has not saved Wesley Madhevere! Scotland are still alive in this game! Very full on middle, Madhevere flicks it to deep square leg and he wants a couple. Safyaan Sharif throws it to the keeper. Matthew Cross whips the bails off. Madhevere dives but he has not made it in.
Chris Sole (3-0-26-0) is back on.
SIX! Shumba has delivered again! Low full toss on middle, Shumba lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Short ball on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Low full toss on the pads, Madhevere flicks it and it goes past the diving keeper and the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Yorker on middle, Shumba works it to long on for one.
Full ball outside off, Madhevere heaves it to long on for a single.

Fullish ball on the pads, Shumba looks to flick but it goes off the inside edge, hits the pads and goes to the off side. A magnificent fifty for Milton Shumba. He has taken Zimbabwe to the cusp of a series win.
Safyaan Sharif is back on. 2-0-16-0 for him so far.
Good-length ball outside off, Madhevere looks to swing it away but misses. 31 needed in 18 balls.
SIX! Fourth six in the over! Zimbabwe are now on top. Low full toss on middle, Madhevere whacks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fullish ball on the pads, Shumba whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Make it three in a row! Now the game is heading towards Zimbabwe! Good-length ball on middle, Shumba smacks it over deep square leg for a biggie. 38 needed in 21 balls.
SIX! Another one! This has been some innings from Milton Shumba so far! Low full toss on middle, Shumba clears his front leg and then whacks it over long on for a maximum.
SIX! What a shot from Shumba! Short ball on middle, Shumba picks up the length and then pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Change. Alasdair Evans is back on. 3-0-14-1 for him so far.
Full on middle, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
SWING AND A MISS! Good-length ball outside off, Madhevere looks to swing it away but misses.
Full on off, Shumba uses his feet and then works it to long on for one.
Fullish ball on middle, Shumba flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region and picks up two.
SIX! Shumba is keeping Zimbabwe in the game! Full around off, Shumba shuffles across and then lifts it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Good-length ball on middle, Madhevere heaves it to deep square leg for a single.

Just short of the fielder! Shorter ball, on off. Milton Shumba looks to whip but does not get the timing. The ball goes towards wide long on. The fielder runs forward and dives but cannot take the catch. 68 needed in the last 5 overs now.
Length ball, on leg. Wesley Madhevere gets the top edge while looking to flick. The ball lands near the mid on region for one.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Full ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere whips it away. The ball goes between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full ball, outside off. Shumba runs it towards third man for a single.
On a length, outside off. Wesley Madhevere heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, outside off. Shumba drags it across the line to deep square leg for one.
Chris Sole is back into the attack. 2-0-16-0 are his figures so far.
FOUR! That is nicely done. Fuller ball, around off. Wesley Madhevere plays the reverse sweep over short third man for a boundary.
Full ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder gets across and stops the ball. Two taken.
Shorter ball, on leg. Wesley Madhevere misses the pull.
Flatter ball, on off. Shumba taps it towards mid-wicket for one.
SIX! All the way! Tossed up, on leg. Shumba takes a step down the track and heaves it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Full ball, outside off. Shumba drills it past covers for a couple of runs.
Quicker ball, on leg. Worked to the leg side for one.
Full ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere works it past mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Hit hard! Full ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it hard to the mid-wicket fence.
Shorter ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere goes back and cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
Shorter ball, around off. Pulled past short fine leg for a couple.
Darted on the pads. Shumba works it away towards mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, around off. Wesley Madhevere misses the drive.
Full ball, on the pads. Milton Shumba works it past mid-wicket for one.
Full ball, outside off. Shumba gets no bat on it.
Tossed up, outside off. Drilled to deep cover for one.
Darted on the pads. Milton Shumba pushes it to long on for one.
Calum MacLeod comes into the attack.
Flatter and fuller ball, outside off. Shumba cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to deep cover for one.
Darted on off. Milton Shumba flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, on off. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Shumba pushes it to point for a single.
Full ball, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere works it past mid-wicket for one.
On middle, tucked to the leg side for one.
Floated on the pads, Madhevere attempts the reverse sweep but gets hit on the pads.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Tossed up on middle and leg, Madhevere looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire turns it down.
Loopy ball on middle, pushed to the off side.
Who will walk out to bat now? Milton Shumba it is.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust! Williams tries to be cheeky but loses his wicket in the process. Scotland right on top. Floated on middle,  Williams looks to reverse sweep but misses and the ball hits the timber behind. Zimbabwe need a big partnership if they want to make a comeback here.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Flighted ball outside off, Williams looks to defend but gets beaten.
Good-length ball on middle, Williams works it to the leg side for one. Excellent over from Alasdair Evans.
Good-length ball on off, Sean Williams defends it out.
Quick single! Fullish ball on off, Wesley pushes it to point and takes a quick single.
Shortish ball outside off, Madhevere cuts it to point.
Good-length ball outside off, Madhevere defends it to point.
Wesley Madhevere walks out to bat now.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! One wicket brings another as Craig Ervine too falls! Scotland will feel they have a good chance of strangling Zimbabwe. Full ball around off, Ervine looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the stumps.
Tossed up on off, Sean pushes it to cover.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Williams lets it go. Wided.
Sean Williams walks out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Leask has the first wicket and that brings an end to a very good opening partnership. Leask bowls a quicker ball on middle, Chakabva looks to defend but is late in bringing his bat down and the ball uproots the middle stump. Scotland are happy. 118 needed in 73 balls.
Loopy ball on middle, Chakabva works it to the right side of the bowler. Leask does well to collect it off his own bowling.
Flighted ball outside off, Ervine drives it to deep cover for a single.
Short on the pads, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Short ball on the pads, Chakabva pulls it to deep mid-wicket and a misfield there allows the batters to pick up two.
Michael Leask to bowl now.
On middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Craig guides it to short third man for a single.
FOUR! Ervine is looking in ominous touch! Tossed up on off, Ervine powers it to long off for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Regis tucks it to the side of the pitch on the leg side for one.
Loopy ball on middle, Ervine nudges it to the leg side for one.
Floated on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Mark Watt to bowl now.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is poor stuff! Short ball on middle, Ervine pulls it to deep square leg. The fielder comes across, but commits a misfield and it goes for a boundary. Zimbabwe are 47 for 0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Around off, RC plays it to third man for a single.
SIX! Top shot from Regis Chakabva! Full on middle and leg, Chakabva lifts it over long on for a biggie.
Full around off, Ervine whips it to deep square leg and picks up a single.
Good-length ball outside off, Ervine looks to drive but misses.
Good length outside off, Chakabva guides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length, on off. Craig Ervine looks to pull but gets hit on the stomach.
Short ball, on leg. Regis Chakabva pulls it with no timing towards deep square leg for a single.
Full ball, on middle and leg. Regis Chakabva pushes it to mid on.
Shorter ball, around off. Craig Ervine misses the pull and gets hit on the body. The ball rolls away and they get a leg bye.
FOUR! Length ball, on the pads. Craig Ervine pulls it to short fine leg. The fielder misfields and it goes for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Craig Ervine looks to drive but misses.
Flatter ball, on off. Regis Chakabva works it to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Length ball, on the pads. Ervine works it off his pads for one.
A good-length ball, around off. Craig Ervine looks to flick but it goes off the leading edge to cover. The fielder there dives but cannot hold on to the ball.
Short of a length, outside off. Pushed to deep point for one.
Length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva looks to block but the ball goes through the gate.
Length ball, around off. Regis Chakabva taps it to point for a single.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to mid off for nothing.
Short of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva misses the pull.
Full ball, outside off. Craig Ervine gets no bat on it. The keeper also fails to collect and a bye is taken.
Full ball, on off. Pushed to mid on for one. No ball called as Chris Sole has overstepped. Free Hit to follow.
Full ball, down the leg side. Regis Chakabva misses the flick. Wide called.
SIX! Smacked! Short ball, around leg. Regis Chakabva pulls it over the square leg fence.
Length ball, on off. Tucked to mid-wicket for one.
Chris Sole is into the attack.
Length ball, on off. Tucked to the leg side for one.
Length ball, outside off. Ervine misses the drive.
FOUR! Cracked! Short ball, outside off. Craig Ervine pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.
Short of a length, outside off. Ervine pushes it to point.
On a length, around off. Pushed to the off side.
Length ball, on the pads. Tucked to fine leg for one.
FIVE WIDES! Free runs for Zimbabwe! Short ball, down the leg side. Left alone and even the keeper cannot stop it from going to the fence.
Who will bowl from the other end? Alasdair Evans it is.
Length ball, on the pads. Craig Ervine works it past square leg for a couple.
Full ball, on off. Blocked out.
Short of a length, around off. Punched past covers for one.
On a length, around off. Pushed to mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched to covers.
Short ball, on off. Regis Chakabva ducks under it.
